proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: comparing fibre categories over T = lim T_i through the commutative diagram with B(T); the bottom arrow is an equivalence because B -> S is locally of finite presentation (limits-of-spaces remark), so one may assume the limit is over B; the category of T-perfect objects of D(O_{X_T}) is the colimit of the T_i-perfect categories (More on Morphisms of Spaces lemma); it remains to descend condition (2): for E_i with derived pullback E satisfying condition (2), the open W of negative-Ext vanishing for E_i contains the image of T, so by the limits-constructible lemma some T_{i'} -> T_i factors through W, and i' works by construction of W (source lines 5620-5662)
